dialogue.scenario1: Mommy, I'm scared of the dark!
dialogue.response1: Baby, Mommy is right here, let's look at the stars outside the window together
dialogue.response2: Come, tell Mommy what you dreamed about? It was just a dream
dialogue.response3: Baby, close your eyes and imagine your favorite safe place, Mommy and Daddy are always here protecting you
dialogue.scenario4: I don't want to go to bed!
dialogue.response4: I understand you want to keep playing, but we agreed, it's time to rest now. How about we read this book and then turn off the lights?
dialogue.response5: There are lots of interesting things in the dark! Fireflies dancing, stars twinkling, and little crickets singing
dialogue.response6: Mommy sees you're really angry, because... Come, let's take deep breaths together, blow the air out like blowing up a balloon
dialogue.response7: That's all for tonight's story, close your eyes, we'll continue our new adventure tomorrow night. Good night, my little warrior
dialogue.response8: Mommy is in the next room, I can hear you anytime. Close your eyes and imagine Mommy giving you a big hug

afraid.title: Response when afraid of darkness
afraid.response: Sweetheart, Mommy is right here. Let's look at the stars outside together. Darkness is like a gentle blanket, softly covering us and protecting us as we sleep

nightmare.title: Comfort after nightmares
nightmare.response: Come, tell Mommy what you dreamed about? That was just a dream, you are safe now, Mommy will always be with you

sleepalone.title: Building bedtime security
sleepalone.response: Sweetheart, close your eyes and imagine your favorite safe place. Mommy and Daddy are always here protecting you

angry.title: Handling child anger
angry.response: Mommy sees you're angry, that's okay. Come, let's take deep breaths together, blow the air out like blowing up a balloon

discipline.title: Gentle and firm guidance
discipline.response: I understand you want to play more, but we agreed it's time to rest. Let's read one more book and then turn off the lights, okay?

separation.title: Easing separation anxiety
separation.response: Mommy is in the next room, I can hear you anytime. Close your eyes and imagine Mommy giving you a big hug
